title: The Almost-Closed Car Door
spec: Close the car door and start getting comfortable. The dashboard announces “Door open.” Open it again and close it harder.

title: The Wrong Quest Reward
spec: Finish a long quest and choose your reward. Just after confirming, realize you selected the wrong sword. The reward window closes permanently.

title: Second Place at the Finish Line
spec: Lead the entire race. With the finish line directly ahead, another car slips past and wins by a few centimeters.

title: The Bedtime Mosquito
spec: Get comfortable, turn off the light, and close your eyes. A mosquito starts whining beside your ear. Turn the light on, and it vanishes.

title: The Shopping Mall Interception
spec: Walk through a shopping mall. A fundraiser steps into your path with a friendly greeting. Sidestep them and immediately encounter another fundraiser.

title: One Light That Doesn’t Match
spec: Switch on a row of identical lamps. All shine bright white except one noticeably dim, yellow bulb. Once you notice it, your eyes keep returning to it.

title: The Safety Cap That Just Spins
spec: Twist a bottle cap, but it only clicks and spins. Notice the tiny “Push down and turn” instruction. Your first attempt still fails to catch.

title: Straight Into the Sun
spec: Turn a corner and face the low sun directly. Search your pockets for sunglasses and find only their empty case.

title: Waiting for Cold Water
spec: Turn the tap to its coldest setting and fill a glass. The water is lukewarm. Empty it, wait, and try again. Still lukewarm.

title: The Slightly Crooked Apartment
spec: Get the keys to your new apartment. Put a marble on the floor and watch it roll steadily into a corner. Check another room. Same result.

title: The Last Fish Finger
spec: Queue at the cafeteria for fish fingers. The person ahead takes the last ones. You reach the serving tray just as it is removed.

title: Three Hours at the Gate
spec: Rush through the airport and finally reach your gate. Nobody is there. Check your boarding pass and discover that boarding starts in three hours.

title: The Disruptive Seatmate
spec: Find a seat on the metro and settle in. The intoxicated passenger beside you starts talking loudly, leaning into your space, and repeatedly bumping your arm.

title: The Bus That Stops Everywhere
spec: Board a bus when you are already in a hurry. Someone requests every stop. Every traffic light turns red. A delivery vehicle then blocks the next street.

title: You’ve Already Seen This Episode
spec: Finally find a promising program. A familiar scene appears. You predict the next line perfectly and realize it is the same repeat you watched recently.

title: The Overwritten Video Tape
spec: Insert a tape labeled with your favorite film. Press Play and discover that somebody recorded an entirely different program over it.

title: The Frozen Water Pipes
spec: Come home thirsty and place a glass beneath the tap. Turn it on. One drop falls, followed by nothing. The pipes are frozen.

title: The Keyring Lottery
spec: Try several almost identical keys in a lock. None turns. The correct key is the final one, hiding behind the keys you already tried.

title: The Door Handle Hook
spec: Walk through a doorway carrying a shoulder bag. Its strap catches on the handle, abruptly pulling you backward just as you think you are through.

title: The Inside-Out Umbrella
spec: Open your umbrella as the rain gets heavier. A gust flips it inside out. Restore its shape, and the next gust immediately folds it backward again.
